input.command:
python3 - <<'EOF'
import socket, base64, os
key=base64.b64encode(os.urandom(16)).decode()
req=("GET /websockify HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: 127.0.0.1\r\nUpgrade: websocket\r\nConnection: Upgrade\r\n"
     f"Sec-WebSocket-Key: {key}\r\nSec-WebSocket-Version: 13\r\nSec-WebSocket-Protocol: binary\r\n\r\n")
s=socket.create_connection(('127.0.0.1',80),5); s.sendall(req.encode())
resp=s.recv(1024).decode(errors='replace')
print(resp.split('\r\n')[0])
for line in resp.split('\r\n'):
    if line.lower().startswith(('sec-websocket-protocol','upgrade','connection')): print(line)
s.close()
EOF
